purpose: Induct economics_app as a high-level application projection of admissible mismatch organization, Distinction Wealth, recovery capacity, and productive coupling.

core_claim.statement: Economics_app is not primitive. It is a projected governance domain arising from preserved, recoverable, and productively coupled organizations of admissible distinction.
core_claim.compressed_form: Economics_app := Projection(ΣD populations under admissible exchange, recovery, and coupling dynamics)

primitive_grounding.reading: A minimum admissible mismatch between conditions.
primitive_grounding.constraint: The primitive is not an object, firm, person, good, currency, market, or resource.

organization_layer.definition: The admissibility-preserving organization operator that orders, couples, bounds, and deforms distinction-generating mismatches into recognizable signatures.
organization_layer.role: Converts mismatch inventory into structured economic possibility.

signature_layer.definition: An admissible organization of distinction-generating conditional mismatches.
signature_layer.economic_reading: A firm, skill, technology, institution, supply chain, market, profession, or scientific field is a projected Sigma_D structure.

economic_projection.definition: Economics_app is the projected domain in which Sigma_D structures exchange, preserve, deform, recover, compete, cooperate, and couple under admissibility constraints.

projection_reading.trade_app: admissible coupling between non-equivalent Sigma_D structures
projection_reading.innovation_app: formation or recoupling of Sigma_D into new admissible organization
projection_reading.recession_app: loss or contraction of recoverable Sigma_D capacity

distinction_wealth_bridge.claim: Distinction Wealth is the bridge from foundational mismatch organization to economics_app.
distinction_wealth_bridge.definition: The amount of admissible difference a system can preserve, recover, adapt, and productively couple without collapsing future continuation.
distinction_wealth_bridge.economic_translation: Wealth is not stored stuff; wealth is preserved admissible organizational capacity.

DI.name: Distinction Inventory
DI.definition: Raw count of distinguishable mismatch candidates.
DI.warning: DI is not wealth until filtered through admissibility and organization.

ADW.name: Admissible Distinction Wealth
ADW.definition: Sigma_D structures capable of lawful participation in continuation.

RDW.name: Realized Distinction Wealth
RDW.definition: Admissible Sigma_D structures actively producing resilience, adaptation, innovation, recovery, or exchange value.

DL.name: Distinction Loss
DL.definition: Collapse, erasure, or unrecoverable narrowing of admissible Sigma_D structures.

DR.name: Distinction Recovery
DR.definition: Ability to restore Sigma_D structures or regenerate equivalent admissible organization after loss.

DE.name: Distinction Efficiency
DE.definition: Effectiveness of converting ADW into RDW.
DE.warning: Must be paired with scale and resilience to avoid rewarding small fragile systems.

DC.name: Distinction Concentration
DC.definition: Degree to which economic Sigma_D capacity is concentrated into few fragile pathways.

candidate_DWI.name: Distinction Wealth Index
candidate_DWI.weighted_form: DWI = w1(ADW) + w2(RDW) + w3(DR) + w4(DE) - w5(DL) - w6(DC_fragility)
candidate_DWI.governance_warning: Weights must remain domain-specific until cross-domain validation exists.

law_1.name: Organization Before Wealth
law_1.statement: Mismatch inventory becomes economic wealth only after admissible organization.

law_2.name: Distinction Loss Constraint
law_2.statement: A system cannot increase long-term realized distinction wealth if structurally significant distinction loss persistently exceeds recovery or regeneration.

law_3.name: Fragmentation Limit
law_3.statement: Increasing raw distinction inventory can reduce wealth if it destroys admissibility, coupling, or recovery capacity.

law_4.name: Coupling Productivity Principle
law_4.statement: Economic growth increases when non-equivalent Sigma_D structures productively couple without collapsing into uniformity.

law_5.name: Resilience Through Redundant Distinction
law_5.statement: Systems with multiple admissible Sigma_D pathways recover better than systems dependent on concentrated single-path organization.

poverty.procedural_definition: Collapse or restriction of admissible organizational options.
poverty.implication: A system may possess resources and still be procedurally poor if recovery, coupling, and Sigma_D diversity are low.

wealth.procedural_definition: Preserved and recoverable admissible organizational capacity.
wealth.implication: Wealth should be measured by future possibility capacity, not merely stored assets.

innovation.procedural_definition: Formation, deformation, or recoupling of Sigma_D into new admissible organization.
innovation.implication: Innovation policy should protect exploratory distinction without allowing fragmentation collapse.

markets.procedural_definition: Admissible coupling environments among Sigma_D structures.
markets.implication: A healthy market preserves many lawful alternatives while enabling productive interaction.

institutions.procedural_definition: High-persistence Sigma_D structures that stabilize admissibility for future exchange.
institutions.implication: Institutional decay is loss of organizational signature, not merely loss of personnel or funding.

supply_chains.procedural_definition: Coupled Sigma_D sequences enabling material and procedural continuation.
supply_chains.implication: Fragility increases when distinction concentration rises and recovery pathways shrink.

test_1.question: Can the same resource inventory generate different economic outcomes under different Org_a structures?

test_2.question: Can a firm_app survive replacement of its components while Sigma_D remains satisfied?
test_2.expected_result: Yes. Identity_app derives from organizational continuity.

test_3.question: Can economic recession be detected as Sigma_D contraction before GDP collapse?

test_4.question: Can recovery_app be measured as re-entry of damaged Sigma_D into admissible organization?

test_5.question: Can excessive DI reduce ADW through fragmentation?
test_5.expected_result: Yes. Raw difference without admissibility can destroy wealth.

patch_1.task: Define Org_a axioms for economic Sigma_D structures.

patch_2.task: Generate example Sigma_D structures for firm_app, market_app, capital_app, and institution_app.

patch_3.task: Test whether economic Sigma_D structures survive admissible deformation.

patch_4.task: Construct preliminary Distinction Wealth Index from ADW, RDW, DR, DL, DE, and DC.

strong_statement: Procedural Economics_app studies how admissible organizations of mismatch become wealth, how they couple into markets, how they persist as institutions, how they collapse as poverty, and how they recover as civilization capacity.

recommendation.priority: Org_a and Sigma_D construction before DWI policy usage.
